source_scope.purpose: Check selected anchor leads on fresh evaluation seeds and repeat training from exactly the same initial full state/RNG. No longer training yet.
limitations: This is mature-checkpoint adaptation, not from-scratch training.
Same-RNGrepeat measures numerical/runtime trajectory variation, not new independent training seeds.
Leads selected using eval42/43; fresh1042/1043/1044 are confirmation for these fixed weights.
Probes use privileged state only for evaluation, fit only on train episodes; no state labels enter training losses.
